desc: Read `N, R, C` and the wind string.
Maintain cumulative displacement and previously encountered prefix positions.
Check whether the target contains smoke using the displacement-offset lookup.
Print the binary answer string in \(O(N)\) expected time and \(O(N)\) space.
Reject explicit smoke-set simulation as infeasible.
Establish that smoke-generation events correspond to previously unseen cumulative prefix positions.
Validate the solution against all three public samples.
